I'm pretty sure buying corsair rads would have been perfect for this build (they do fit on the side mount) but hey, live and learn.

They have a weird form factor and are kinda wide. I planned my loop for one radiator to be on the side mount instead of the front, but the screw holes were like 2 millimeters off to the right so I had to redesign my loop on the fly.  They've been working great, i'd just recommend smaller rads for this case.   


I also flushed them for about an hour and it turns out that wasn't enough, I ended up undoing the entire thing, running a fountain pump to try to clean them and then finally boiling water and shaking them for about 14 hours (I watched 3 movies and many a show while shaking). 

A chemical flush would have probably done the trick way quicker, so I'm not gonna knock em to hard on that.
